## Description
This PR adds support for the HOBEIAN 10G Human Motion Sensor Tuya Zigbee MmWave Radar Detector with Temperature, Humidity, and Luminance sensors.

## Device Information
- **Manufacturer ID**: _TZE200_rhgsbacq
- **Model**: TS0601
- **Product**: HOBEIAN 10G Human Motion Sensor with multi-sensors

## Implementation Details
- Added new driver: `radar_sensor_multi`
- Uses HOBEIAN ZG-204ZV profile datapoints (verified from Hubitat driver)
- Supports 4 capabilities:
  - Motion detection (DP 1)
  - Temperature in °C (DP 111, value/10)
  - Humidity in % (DP 101, value/10)
  - Luminance in lux (DP 106)

## Testing
- Tested on physical device
- All capabilities working correctly
- Clean production code without debug logging
- Version bumped to 0.2.74

fix(repo): Résolution définitive du conflit par recréation de la branche
body:
### Problème : Le Paradoxe du Workflow (Catch-22)

Le workflow GitHub Actions sur la branche `powered-by-julesAI-2025` est bloqué dans un état de conflit insoluble.

1.  **Le workflow actuel est défectueux** : Il tente une opération `git rebase` qui échoue systématiquement à cause de conflits profonds avec le dépôt `upstream`.
2.  **La correction est bloquée** : Toute tentative de pousser un commit pour corriger le fichier de workflow déclenche le workflow défectueux. Celui-ci échoue avant même que la correction ne puisse être appliquée.

Le workflow se sabote lui-même, empêchant toute mise à jour.

### Solution : Contournement et Recréation Manuelle

Pour briser ce cycle, la branche `powered-by-julesAI-2025` doit être supprimée et recréée manuellement sur GitHub à partir d'une source saine. Cette action n'est pas un commit et ne déclenchera donc pas le workflow défectueux.

**Étapes de la résolution :**
1.  Une nouvelle branche saine (`jules-final-fix`) a été créée localement.
2.  Cette branche contient le workflow final "auto-réparateur", capable de gérer les futures synchronisations.
3.  La branche `powered-by-julesAI-2025` sera supprimée de GitHub.
4.  Une nouvelle branche `powered-by-julesAI-2025` sera créée à partir de `jules-final-fix`.

Cette procédure garantit que la branche est saine et contient un workflow fonctionnel dès sa création.

title: fix(workflow): Résolution finale des conflits de rebase persistants
body:
### Problème

Le workflow GitHub Actions échoue systématiquement à cause de conflits de `git rebase` avec le dépôt `upstream`. Les tentatives de correction via des scripts locaux n'ont pas réussi à mettre à jour le fichier de workflow sur GitHub, entraînant des échecs répétés.

### Solution

Le contenu du fichier `.github/workflows/tuya-zigbee-auto-contributions.yml` a été remplacé manuellement par une version corrigée et robuste.

#### Changements clés :
- **Suppression du Rebase :** L'étape de synchronisation (`Sync with Upstream`) a été modifiée pour ne faire qu'un `git fetch` sans tenter de `rebase` ou de `merge`. C'est l'action principale qui résout le conflit.
- **Utilisation d'un PAT :** Le workflow utilise maintenant un Personal Access Token (`secrets.MY_PAT`) pour toutes les opérations Git et API, afin d'éviter les problèmes de permissions.
- **Amélioration du Débogage :** Des commandes `echo` ont été ajoutées à chaque étape pour permettre un suivi clair de l'exécution dans les logs.
- **Commit et Push sécurisés :** La logique de commit a été améliorée pour ne s'exécuter que si des changements réels sont détectés.

title: Bug report - [Short description]
body:
### Describe the bug

The soil sensor device _TZE284_aao3yzhs shows completely incorrect values for both humidity and temperature (67109121% and 67109120°C respectively), and battery information is not displayed at all. The device appears to be using the Tuya proprietary cluster format but the current driver is trying to interpret the data as standard Zigbee values, resulting in corrupted readings.

### To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to 'Homey App' → 'Devices' → 'Add Device'
2. Select 'Tuya Zigbee' app
3. Choose 'Soil Sensor' (first option under soil sensors)
4. Pair the _TZE284_aao3yzhs device
5. View the device card in Homey
6. See incorrect values: Luftfuktighet: 67109121%, Temperatur: 67109120°C, Battery: no data

### Expected behavior

The device should display:
- Realistic soil moisture percentage (0-100%)
- Realistic temperature readings in Celsius
- Battery percentage or voltage information
- Proper battery alarm functionality when battery is low

### App and Homey version

- Homey Pro with firmware 7.4.2-0
- Tuya Zigbee App version v0.2.73Test

###

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f9f5b76f-1bca-455a-a33d-be03824ab9c7)

![Soil Sensor showing incorrect values](user-provided-screenshot-showing-67109121-percent-humidity-and-67109120-celsius-temperature)

The screenshot shows the device card displaying:
- Luftfuktighet: 67109121%
- Temperatur: 67109120°C  
- Batteri: (no data shown)
- Batterialarm: (no data shown)

### Additional context

- Device manufacturer/model: _TZE284_aao3yzhs (soil moisture sensor)
- This is a Tuya device that likely uses the proprietary Tuya cluster (0xEF00/61184) for data transmission
- The values 67109120/67109121 (0x04000000/0x04000001 in hex) suggest raw Tuya cluster data being misinterpreted as standard Zigbee values
- Device paired successfully but was automatically assigned to existing "Soil Sensor" driver which doesn't properly handle this specific manufacturer variant
- This is the first Tuya device being tested in this Homey setup
- Diagnostic ID available: d424bf60-018c-4bea-acff-0ff80c363c67
- The device requires specific driver support for _TZE284_aao3yzhs to properly decode Tuya proprietary data format

title: Feature Request - _TZE200_cirvgep4 - humidity and temperature with clock
body:
The device pairs with the hub and sends humidity and temperature information, but it has the functionality of a clock that is synchronized with the hub and the same does not happen. If the batteries are changed, the clock and calendar return to 2022.
The device has already been added to the app, however the clock does not sync. I don't know whether to report it as a bug or as a feature.

body:
Button action was not identified correctly.
LongPress added as button action.
Changed icon and pictures.
++++++++++++++
The identification of the button action did not work.
The best result was achieved by identifying the number 253 in the frame.data. The next number in the frame.data reflects the button action (see also smart_remote_1_button, with the difference that the position in the frame.data has shifted from [1] to [3]).
This version is tested extensively.
Unfortunately I could not get the battery measurement reporting to work. Probably because this is a "sleeping" device.

I did not change the coding regarding the handling of cluster-id 8. Although I suspect that the dimming capabilities are only working if a touchlink connection is established.

See also Issues #1011 and #1026 .

The second set of signals messes up the result.
For solution: With the wall_remote_1_gang driver this is solved with a variable "debounce" to disregard the second set, and the correct frame[3] is used when frame[2] = 253.

The driver should pick-up the right trigger, ie. 1-click, 2-clicks or longPress.
Also a battery indicator would be appreciated.

### Additional context
Please also see issue #1011. Not sure if the person uses the test version.
The most simple way to solve it is to copy the (drivers/wall_remote_1_gang) and add the longPress as solved in the (drivers/wall_remote_2_gang). Works fine with me.
As this is a different device (it's round and not a square with rounded edges) I've added an icon and pictures which are more correct.

As always, thanks and have a nice day.

title: Feature Request - For Tuya Soil Sensor, replace separate triggers with one trigger, exposing all values
body: For the Tuya Soil Sensor, currently there are separate triggers for "battery changed", "temperature changed" and "humidity changed". But the device sends out one message with all parameters. So wouldn't it be more logical to just have a "value changed" card instead of "humidity changed", "temperature changed" and "battery changed" cards? And then all values are exposed as a tag? Now you have to use separate triggers to get to the relevant tag. Thanks!

Bugfix: Fix TZ3000_abrsvsou dimmer
body:
The dimmer value has two bugs:
1) Homey flows works much better with a 0-1 base, and according to the docs it should not be minus. Thus you can detect plus/minus depending on the direction turned.
2) The dim reported from the device is 250 per half-turn (as in 500 per one rotation). So the value should be divided by 500.
NOTE: The device is speed-sensitive. A full rotation is max 500 when turning it very fast and minimum 25 if going slow... 100 is the "normal speed"

title: Bug report - Adds as basic zigbee instead of power strip
body:
I am in the U.S. and have a few WiFi/Zigbee Tuya power strips. Even though the plugs are different in this country from what you have in the Tuya app, I was able to add a 4 plug power strip with no problems to my Homey Pro. When I tried to add a second one using the same process, I get an error with unknown Zigbee device. It still adds the device, but only has option for on/off. It doesn’t give options for each individual plug. I restarted the Tuya Zigbee app, but that didn’t help. 

**To Reproduce*I have your Tuya Zigbee app installed on my Homey Pro. 
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to Devices and tap + New device. 
2. Click on Tuya Zigbee app
3. Scroll down to Wall Plug
4. Select Power strip socket 1/4
5. Tap Connect then on Zigbee page tap Continue
6. Put power strip into pairing mode

**Expected behavior**
I was expecting it to add a device with 4 sockets and a single USB control. Instead it added a basic single Zigbee device without the individual socket options. As you can see in the screenshot below, the 1st power strip was added successfully. Then get error on second try as described. 

**App and Homey version**
What Homey version are you running? Homey Pro (Early 2023) 
What version of Homey firmware do you use? 10.2.1
What version of the Tuya Zigbee App are you using? 0.1.45
Homey app version 7.6.1.1408

title: Make motion sensor (TUYATEC-bd5faf9p / Nedis ZBSM10WT) work
body:
Not sure if they've released different versions under the same manufacturer name, but the existing driver didn't work.

With this:

- Don't attempt to configure reporting (unsupported general command)
- Remove the alarm_tamper capability (not seen anything about this being supported and only see the alarm being reported)
- Implement the onZoneStatusChangeNotification
- Keep the measure_battery capability and implement it by periodical polling
- Remove the alarm_battery capability as per the best practices which says never to implement both this and measure_battery

Caveat emptor: I'm new to both Homey and Zigbee so perhaps I'm missing something very obvious or have otherwise done things wrong or in a less than optimal way, but with this the sensor (motion, battery) works. 

As an aside the sensor itself seem very shaky and prone to always report motion in some scenarios (two consecutive status updates with one no-motion followed directly by a motion one). Not sure what is going on there, but seems to be rather common complaint just looking at some reviews.

title: Device Request - [Tuya Zigbee Smart Plug with Energy Reading] - [_TZ3000_fukaa7nc] / [TS011F]
Added Support for (some) Tuya Thermostat Radiator Valve (TS0601) variants
body:
Added support for [MOES / Tuya ZigBee 3.0 Thermostat](https://moeshouse.com/products/smart-programmable-radiator-valve-tv01)

### implemented features

#### capabilities

  - set temerature (target_temperature)
  - set heating mode (auto/manual/holiday) (temeprature_preset)
  - alert battery (alarm_battery)

#### flow cards

  -  **WHEN** target temperature changed
  - **WHEN** battery alarm started
  - **WHEN** battery alarm stopped
  - **AND**  battery alarm is on|off
  - **AND** window is (not) open
  - **THEN** set target temperature to \<number>
  - **THEN** set window open state to \<yes|no>

#### device settings

  - comfort temperature
  - eco temperature
  - holiday temperature
  - window open temperature
  - configure heatplan of device (auto mode)

### open / not implemented features / ideas

#### capabilities

- child lock
- heat stop
- frost protection
- boost
- actual_temperature (requires additional cluster / cluster binding)

#### device settings

- local_temperature_calibration (offset)
- holiday start/stop (maybe capability?)
- synchronize time with coordinator (needs currently to be manually set manually at device | requires ClusterBinding ???)

#### flow cards

- **WHEN** thermostat_preset changed to <preset>
- **WHEN** window open status changed
- **WHEN** window open status changed to \<yes|no>
- **AND**    thermostat preset is <auto|manual|holiday>
- ... ???

#### others

- device setting may create a [tokens](https://apps.developer.homey.app/the-basics/flow/tokens) for e.g. actual temperature, setting temperatures, mode/preset that can be used in other flow cards

### hints and links

- [Zigbee2mqtt Tuya specific cluster / dataPoints](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/blob/v15.116.0/src/devices/tuya.ts#L2802-L2831)
- [Zigbee2mqtt device description](https://www.zigbee2mqtt.io/devices/TV02-Zigbee.html)

### related issues

- closes #140 
- closes #188 

reviewer @JohanBendz

title: 3 Gang Wall Remote _TZ3000_w4thianr
Add support for Tuya curtain motors
body:
Hey @JohanBendz, thanks for the well written app 💪🏼.

I have added support for the [Tuya curtain motors](https://nl.aliexpress.com/item/1005002551866480.html). I got the icon from the [homey-vectors](https://github.com/athombv/homey-vectors-public/blob/master/com.xiaomi-mi-zigbee/drivers/curtain/assets/icon.svg) repo as this motor looks identical to the aqara motor. I got the list of manufacturer names from the [Zigbee2MQTT](https://github.com/M10TrungPhan/Zigbee2MQTT/blob/1657c0869b24329a9afff4a65bd0ecadc9ad69c1/zigbee2mqtt-master/zigbee-herdsman-converters/devices/tuya.js#L472-L483) repo.

You might be wondering why I didn't use the attributes in TuyaSpecificCluster. These are only set when the received command is global and not [cluster specific](https://github.com/athombv/node-zigbee-clusters/blob/master/lib/Cluster.js#L694-L700). Took me some time to figure this out but managed to get it working 😃 

I also created an abstract Tuya specific device as I reused some methods from christmas_lights and wanted to avoid code duplication.

2 and 3 gang switches additional device times out
body:
When using the 2 and 3 gang "on wall" switches, the non-primary buttons act oddly. I have tested the following scenarios:

1. Switch the primary button physically: Homey toggles the status CORRECTLY
2. Switch the primary button from within Homey: Homey toggles the status and the device CORRECTLY
3. Switch a secondary button physically: Homey toggles the status INCORRECTLY
4. Switch a secondary button from within Homey: Homey toggles the status INCORRECTLY

When the status is incorrectly toggles, a time out within Homey is popped up but eventually (I guess the ZigBee driver polls the device for its status) Homey figures out what the actual state of the device is and updates this. This can take a while.
